en: The image shows a picturesque harbor with several sailboats docked along the waterfront. The shoreline is lined with historical buildings with red-tiled roofs, and there is a distinct church with a tall bell tower. Behind the town are rolling green hills and mountains. The colors and printing style suggest an old, hand-colored postcard. The text 'Gruž-Gravosa.' appears in the top left corner.
